about: Rules for exact matching (archive/match.py). Exact matching finds a label's words in a passage; it cannot read context. Labels listed under context_required are not matched automatically: they are too short, too common or ambiguous, and wait for the Phase 3 reading, which sees the context. Acronyms of three characters or fewer are skipped unless allowed below; acronyms are always matched with their capital letters. Edit freely; re-run 'python -m archive match'.

allowed_short_acronyms.SSA: Core euphemism of the field; other meanings (Social Security Administration, sub-Saharan Africa) are rare in this corpus and show up in samples.
allowed_short_acronyms.AGP: Blanchard's autogynephilia; distinctive in this corpus.
allowed_short_acronyms.GID: Gender Identity Disorder, obsolete DSM category, common in older sources.

context_required.gay: Identity word (GOV.UK reference list); everywhere in the corpus.
context_required.homosexual: Identity word; used by all sides.
context_required.seelsorge: Ordinary German word for pastoral care; the loophole sense needs context.
context_required.map: Ordinary word; the 'minor attracted person' sense needs context.
context_required.apa: Also APA citation style and other associations.
context_required.stonewall: The riots, the UK charity and the verb.
